exactPrompt: Edit this specific Bihac pixel-art game background. Keep its existing 16-bit no-black-outline rendering, pixel-cluster size, camera, framing, dimensions, river, cascades, wooded hills, recognizable square hipped-roof stone tower and completely uninterrupted flat foreground strip. Do not make it chunkier and do not return to detailed realism. The requested change is stronger, readable WWII YUGOSLAV PARTISAN WARTIME ATMOSPHERE, because the current damaged village still feels too much like a pleasant postcard. Add a few purposeful environmental storytelling details integrated into the architecture: (1) rough dark red hand-painted partisan graffiti on the broad wall of the LEFT damaged ordinary house, exactly two short lines 'SMRT' and 'FAŠIZMU', with a small simple red five-pointed star nearby. Letters are paint directly on damaged plaster, with imperfect edges, not a UI label or a poster. Keep it readable without making it dominate the picture. (2) One modest worn Yugoslav partisan cloth flag hanging from a short pole attached to a middle-distance house facade nearer the center, well away from screen corners: horizontal BLUE-WHITE-RED tricolor with a clear red five-pointed star centered on the white band, no hammer-and-sickle and no national crest. Cloth must belong to the building and fit the same pixel style; no flag on every roof. (3) Clearly blackened and scorched plaster around several broken windows and under destroyed eaves, with exposed roof timbers visibly charred black/brown and cold ash among selected rubble. Group the soot damage, do not uniformly darken every surface or the entire image. (4) A few restrained clustered bullet scars in ordinary house walls. Preserve the landmark tower's identifiable shape and the quieter wall/earth areas behind units; put most storytelling on ordinary middle-distance buildings. These are illustrative wartime details, not claims of a documented photograph. NO flames, glowing fires, smoke plumes, people, corpses, modern objects, UI or extra text. Keep colors readable and the geometry of the gameplay ground identical. Output only the edited opaque landscape image.
